why: A khaki dress in her green family under a fitted classic blazer, with beige slingbacks and an olive belt, reads as smart and classic for a seated theatre evening at formality 6-7. The green clutch is a deliberate single spark that echoes the dress, so I accept the loud-accent, orphan and chroma-budget remarks, along with the two lustrous surfaces and the six-item count. They cost little here because the rest of the outfit is tonal and quiet.
